title: AI cloud company Boost Run secures $525.6m contract with Cohere
source_used: TradingView News (AI summary of Boost Run 8-K, 6 Oct 2026)
key_facts: Boost Run (BRUN) entered a service agreement with Cohere for dedicated GPU cloud computing infrastructure and related services.
Contract totals about $525.6 million over about five years per rack, with a portion payable as a prepayment.
Initial acceptances are expected to begin in Q2 2027.
Cohere may terminate and receive refunds if a specified minimum is not accepted by 15 Jul 2027; Boost Run guarantees refunds of unused prepayments.
The filing is an 8-K dated 6 Oct 2026.
A Crypto Briefing headline (not read in full) says the deal pushes Boost Run's total contract value past $2.6 billion.
